tasks.description: Add a search box to the app's main navigation bar. The search box should be prominent and easily accessible. It should also have a clear placeholder text to guide the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the main page, when they click on the search box, then the cursor is focused on the search box
Given a user is on the main page, when they type in the search box, then the search box displays the typed text

tasks.description: Develop a backend endpoint to handle search queries. This endpoint should accept the search query as input and return relevant results. The results should be in a format that can be easily parsed by the frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the query is sent to the backend endpoint, then the endpoint returns relevant results
Given a search query, when the query is sent to the backend endpoint, then the results are in a parsable format

tasks.description: Display the search results in a user-friendly format. The results should include relevant information such as title, description, and a link to the result. The results should also be ordered by relevance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the results are displayed, then the results are ordered by relevance
Given a search query, when the results are displayed, then each result includes a title, description, and link

tasks.description: Validate the search query to prevent malicious input. The validation should check for invalid characters and query length.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the query contains invalid characters, then the query is rejected
Given a search query, when the query exceeds the maximum length, then the query is rejected

tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests for the search feature. The tests should cover different scenarios such as valid and invalid search queries, empty results, and results with multiple pages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when the query is valid, then the test passes
Given a search query, when the query is invalid, then the test passes
